query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Frankenstein, Bob gets The Pearl, and Claire gets The Odyssey.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Alice swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Bob and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Frankenstein
(B) The Pearl
(C) The Odyssey
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Plan: Track the book swaps step-by-step to determine which book Bob ends up with at the end.
Bob ends up with The Odyssey (C).
NOTE Initially, Alice has Frankenstein, Bob has The Pearl, and Claire has The Odyssey.
NOTE After the first swap between Bob and Alice, Bob has Frankenstein and Alice has The Pearl. Claire still has The Odyssey.
